summary: P0 bug fix verified — flagship station logos now render correctly. All 11 flagship logo assets serve HTTP 200 with correct image content-types from /api/static/flagship_logos/. Both design variants (Legacy and RadioLife) display 7/7 AE flagship logos as real images (naturalWidth > 0, no data-URI fallback triggered). API returns proper relative logo_url paths for all 7 AE + 4 US flagships. Mobile bottom-tabs regression intact.
action_items: Pre-existing (out of scope for this bug): broken image URL concatenation `https://mobile-games-v2.preview.emergentagent.comhttps//images.unsplash.com/...` — some component is prepending the host to an already-absolute URL, causing ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED for a hero unsplash image. Not related to flagship logos.
Pre-existing (out of scope): multiple React warnings 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' — needs refactor to pass key explicitly.
critical_code_review_comments: TigrisFallbackStaticFiles mount at /api/static/flagship_logos works correctly — all 11 files served with proper Content-Type (png/webp/vnd.microsoft.icon).

FlagshipStrip.jsx correctly prefers s.logo_url over s.favicon; onError SVG fallback did NOT trigger for any of the 14 image loads observed (7 in Legacy + 7 in RadioLife), confirming real images loaded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for flagship logos (Tigris 403 -> local /api/static/flagship_logos/) is fully verified. curl tests: all 11 slugs (talk-1003-uae.png, luv-1071-uae.png, big-1062-uae.png, beat-978-uae.webp, beat-anthems.webp, urban-beat.webp, chilled-luv.webp, vanakkam-fm-us.png, apna-punjab-us.ico, telugu-sangam-us.png, funasia-fm-dallas.webp) return HTTP 200 with real image content-types. API /api/stations/flagship?region=AE returns 7 items, ?region=US returns 4 items, each with logo_url set to '/api/static/flagship_logos/{slug}.{ext}'. Browser rendering confirmed 7/7 images loaded with naturalWidth>0 in both ?design=legacy and ?design=radiolife (both use same home-flagship-strip testid). Mobile 375x812 bottom-tabs regression still passes. Ignore pre-existing unrelated console noise (React key-spread warnings, one broken unsplash concat URL).
rca of the issue: Original bug: Tigris bucket returning HTTP 403 for logo assets in browser (private bucket). Fix: (1) logos stored on backend disk at /app/backend/static/flagship_logos/, (2) static mount at /api/static/flagship_logos via TigrisFallbackStaticFiles in server.py, (3) DB logo_url/favicon updated to relative path, (4) FlagshipStrip.jsx prefers logo_url and uses inline SVG initials fallback. Verified end-to-end from user perspective.
